name: context-label
description: The context window's fill (percent and used/total) always shown in the prompt footer, beside the model name

yellow_at.title: Yellow from (% of the window)
yellow_at.description: Turn yellow at this share of the context window, 0 to 100; 0 is off. Orange and red win over it when they are reached first.

haiku_price_step.title: Yellow at the Haiku 100k price step
haiku_price_step.description: On Haiku 5.5, turn yellow from 100k tokens, where its price per token goes up 5x, instead of the share above.

orange_at.title: Orange from (% of the way to auto-compact)
orange_at.description: Turn orange at this share of the way to auto-compact (of the whole window when auto-compact is off), 0 to 100; 0 is off. Set above red, it never shows.

red_at.title: Red from (% of the way to auto-compact)
red_at.description: Turn red at this share of the way to auto-compact (of the whole window when auto-compact is off), 0 to 100; 0 is off. On a 1M window with auto-compact near its end, 93% is close to 900k.

show.title: Show
show.description: What the footer shows: the four-square bar, the ctx text, or both.
